lens: Skeptic: every detail is treated as wrong until a real photo shows it right. Official ANA photos y_47300-07 set colours and finishes; SANspotter NH7 2023 (sans_13/15/17/20) and fr57325_* set geometry and unshown details. Measurements are PIL/numpy/scipy on matched regions: L50, p90/p50, p90/p10, Otsu light fraction, detrended column/row profile CV, gradient anisotropy gy/gx, and blob counts per dm2 after resampling to the same mm/px. Fabrics were also judged on 1:1 physical-scale photo/tile sheets (tile linear ratio x navy base, at 1.64 mm/px for y_47306 middle/left and 0.95 mm/px for y_47306 right). Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA11/ (m1-m4.py, sheet.py, fabsheet.png, mosaic095.png, p00z/q15z, p06l/p06r, q16cmp, q16cov, e3z). Lighting is scored separately: the r10 economy darkening is gone in r11.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-1 / w10b-8 Tick weave had no column structure (knit V-stitch rain)
priorIssues.status: partially fixed; overshoots at close range
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 3, detrended column CV 0.058 -> 0.086, against y_47300 s1 0.144 and s3 0.194. Col/row 1.14 -> 3.52, against 4.7-5.3. At the same 1.64 mm/px, the tile now has column CV 0.183 against y_47306 middle 0.051, and p90/p10 2.35 against 3.91. The chevron strokes in y_47306 middle (paired slanted 3-5 mm ticks in about 3.5 mm columns) were real. They have been replaced by straight 1-2 px vertical bars with pure-navy channels, which read as 'digital rain' on the pans (e1, e7).

priorIssues.issue: w10a-2 / w10b-2 Diamond: isolated crisp polka-diamonds
priorIssues.evidence: fabsheet.png: the figures now chain corner to corner in a continuous lattice, with a vertical pitch of about 57 mm against about 49 mm in y_47306 left; no empty sites. Remaining: the figures are a regular argyle, while the photo is ragged, houndstooth-notched stepped figures. The interiors show a pixel-crunchy mottle. Tile p90/p50 is 1.46 against photo 1.70 (slightly flat now).

priorIssues.issue: w10a-3 Head-on (q15), the satin covers are 1.6-2.9x as bright as the backs
priorIssues.status: not fixed (the ratio improved only because the lighting brightened the backs)
priorIssues.evidence: q15 cover L50 r10 -> r11: 60/104/107/60 -> 77/106/107/76. The middle covers did not darken at all despite yCover #535b7c->#4c5474 and r 0.38->0.40. y_47300 covers are 64/47/38/35. Cover/back is now 1.13/1.34/1.46/1.41 against 0.69/0.89/0.55/0.74. Render colour #60688b against photo #1e253d-#393f5b. The middle covers mirror the centre ceiling light.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-4 / w10b-4 Dash mosaic read as vertical barcode columns / chunky bars
priorIssues.status: partially fixed (barcode gone; now a sparse, too-blue speckle)
priorIssues.evidence: mosaic095.png at 0.95 mm/px: y_47306 right is a dense field of near-white horizontal dash rows, packed about every 2 mm and running into each other inside about 20 x 15 mm blocks of differing density. The tile is scattered short saturated-blue dashes with much empty navy. Light 0.23 against 0.33; p90/p10 2.29 against 4.77; gy/gx 1.23 against 1.60. In q15 seat 2 it reads as blotchy heather, not a dash mosaic.

It reads as a fat bright tube along the top edge (q16cov.png), not a thin leatherette sheet folded over the pad.

issues.title: Head-on, the headrest covers are still 1.1-1.5x as bright as the backs; in y_47300 they are 0.55-0.9x
issues.evidence: q15 cover L50 77/106/107/76, against y_47300 64/47/38/35. The middle covers are unchanged from r10 (104-107), so the yCover base darkening had no effect: the term is specular from the centre ceiling light. Render #60688b against photo #1e253d-#393f5b. In sans_13 (in service) the covers are also darker than the fabric. q16 near is closer: 77 against y_47301 51, cover/back 0.89 against 0.66.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yCover: c '#3a4060', r 0.40 -> 0.62, l LAYER.leather (the gap10 suggestion; it gives satin grain without a mirror lobe). In 09a_econ.js, tip the main flap plate 3-4 deg so its face normal points slightly down (rotate the 0.55-0.73 SEC z-offsets so the foot sits 6-8 mm further forward than the top) so the head-on view does not reflect the ceiling. Targets: q15 cover/back 0.7-1.0, q16 near 0.65-0.9.

issues.title: Dash mosaic is a sparse, saturated-blue speckle; the photo is a dense field of near-white horizontal dash rows in rectangular blocks
issues.evidence: mosaic095.png (0.95 mm/px, y_47306 right): light 0.33, p90/p10 4.77, gy/gx 1.60. The tile gives 0.23, 2.29 and 1.23. The photo dashes are whitish (#b8c2dc) and continuous along rows spaced about 2 mm, so the rows nearly touch. Blocks of about 20 x 15 mm differ in density and brightness, with thin dark seams between blocks. The tile dashes are #5a78d8-ish blue, isolated, and leave about 60 % empty navy. In q15 seat 2 it reads as blotchy heather.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): put one dash row every 2 px (2 mm at 1 mm/px) across the whole cell. In each row, lay dashes end to end with lognormal length (median 4, p90 12 px) and 1-2 px gaps, so occupancy is 55-75 % in dense blocks and 30-40 % in sparse ones. Make dashes 1 px tall. Use a near-neutral lift (6.5, 6.8, 6.0) instead of the blue tint, and give each block a brightness of 0.7-1.1. Draw a 1 px darker seam (x0.6) on block borders. Targets on a 1:1 sheet: light 0.30-0.35, p90/p10 above 3.5, gy/gx above 1.5. Alternatively, follow gap10-3(a) and cut it from y_47306 (590, 425, 742, 577).

issues.title: Tick tile overshot: straight vertical bars with pure-navy channels read as digital rain close up, yet the columns are still too weak at row distance
issues.evidence: At 1.64 mm/px against y_47306 middle, the tile column CV is 0.183 against 0.051 and p90/p10 is 2.35 against 3.91. The photo strokes are paired slanted 3-5 mm chevron ticks, bright (p90/p50 2.15), on a mid-navy ground with no clean channels. At q15 distance, seat 3 column CV is 0.086 against y_47300 s1/s3 0.14-0.19 (16 mm column period). The study pans in e1 and e7 look like a pixel barcode.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick(): draw each tick as a 2-px chevron (two 1-px strokes slanted about ±25 deg, 3-5 px long), not a vertical bar. Keep the ~3.5 mm column pitch. Replace the navy channels with a soft column-density envelope: tick brightness x (0.55 + 0.45 x a raised-cosine at a 15-16 mm period, jittered ±2 mm per band), so the fine scale has no hard channel but row distance shows columns. Raise the lift to about (10, 10, 7.5) with the ground at 1.0 so p90/p10 is about 3.5-4. Targets: tile column CV 0.06-0.09 at 1.64 mm/px; q15 seat 3 column CV at least 0.13.

issues.title: Fabric mix under-represents the tick weave and over-represents fleck
issues.evidence: econFab ([tick, fleck, mosaic, fleck, diamond]) gives 20 % tick and 40 % fleck backs. y_47300 backs are 2 tick / 2 fleck. y_47301's visible backs are mostly tick. sans_13 shows tick and diamond backs with fleck mainly on pads. In q16 the render reads as fleck snow and diamonds over most rows.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.12: econFab list -> [yFabric, yFabricD, yFabric, yFabricC, yFabric, yFabricB] (index % 6) for about 50 % tick, 17 % each of the others. Keep the pads fleck (yHead) on tick backs, as y_47300 and y_47306 middle show.

issues.title: Cover top roll is a fat solid tube; the flap still hangs too short
issues.evidence: q16cov.png: a 2.8 cm deep bright bead runs along the cover top. In y_47301 near, y_47306 and sans_13 the top is a thin sheet folded over the pad with a soft radius, and the sheet edge is visible at the sides. The drop below the pad is about 16 % of the pad height (e4) against 26-29 % (y_47306 left/middle/right).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js cover roll loft: keep the depths at 0.004-0.006 (a sheet) and move the section z-offsets along a 1.5 cm radius arc (z = -0.0985 + 0.015(1-cos a), y = 0.764 + 0.015 sin a, for a = 0..180 deg in 6 steps), so the roll is a curved sheet, not a solid. Extend the plate start from 0.55 to 0.525 and move the hem, stitch and logo down 0.025.

issues.title: Tray face still carries a 3-socket item with red marks; handset still narrow
issues.evidence: q18, e9, e2: the item is present. sans_15 and sans_17 show a tray-tilt pictogram placard (white with yellow/black icons) at the left, a grey latch at the centre and a round cup recess at the right; the power outlet is the black box by the pocket (sans_20). Handset width is 0.39 of the bezel, against 0.46 (sans_15) and 0.50 (y_47305).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: replace the red-socket item with a 0.07 x 0.025 m placard, #e4e4df, with two #2a2a2a pictogram quads and one #d8b030 quad. Scale the handset housing width by 1.2 (keep its height).

issues.title: Seat pans are desaturated and pale
issues.evidence: Studio pans B/R 1.38-1.49 against y_47300 1.79-1.88. The tick lift (8, 8, 6) whitens up-facing cushions.
issues.fix: As w10b-7: add SEATMAT.yFabricPan {c: photoBase('#46527a','y_tick'), r 0.92, l LAYER.yJacq} for econPan tick entries, or a bluer tick lift (8, 8.5, 9.5) in synth_y_tick.

issues.title: Armrests are still straight boxes on a vertical post
issues.evidence: e7 and e1 are unchanged. y_47300 and y_47303 show a slender arm sloping down toward the front with a J curve into the spreader.
issues.fix: As w10a-7: loft the arm along a 3-point spline (rear 0.60 -> front 0.56 m), tapering 55 -> 40 mm, with a curved support from 70 % of its length down to the spreader.

issues.title: Pillow centre tuft and near-view fleck brightness
issues.evidence: e4b and e7 show a button dimple; the y_47300 and sans_13 pillows have none. In q16 the near-view flecks are near-white #9caaca petals; the y_47301 near pad specks are smaller and light blue. Fleck/bg is 1.64 against 1.9 at row distance, so do not dim it further. Shrink it instead.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow: drop the exp() dimple term (set 0.12 -> 0). make_swatches.py y_fleck(): shift the half-axis lognormal centre down about 20 % and tint the lift bluer (6.5, 6.5, 6.8), keeping the count.

questionsForUser: Do y_47300 seats 1 and 3 (vertical brick-column look at distance) and the y_47306 middle seat (fine chevron ticks) show the same fabric? If you have any close-up of the main tick fabric from your own flights, it would settle whether the weave is chevron strokes or straight columns.

Headrest covers: every ANA photo and sans_13 show them darker than the fabric in normal light. Is it acceptable to target cover/back about 0.7-0.9 everywhere, even though the bright in-flight cove light makes them look grey from the aisle in some trip reports?
